parrafo.es: Jeremy y su equipo mueven tus cosas en Jacksonville con el mismo cuidado que si fueran propias. Nada de dejar la mudanza en manos de desconocidos: el dueño está ahí, cargando con el equipo.
parrafo.en: Jeremy and his crew move your things across Jacksonville with the same care as if they were their own. No handing your move off to strangers: the owner is right there, loading alongside the crew.

parrafo_1.es: Marvelous Movers es el equipo de Jeremy en Jacksonville: mudanzas residenciales, de apartamento y entregas de muebles grandes. Lo que distingue a Marvelous es que el dueño esta presente y cargando en cada trabajo, no solo coordinando.
parrafo_1.en: Marvelous Movers is Jeremy's crew in Jacksonville: residential moves, apartment moves and large furniture delivery. What sets Marvelous apart is that the owner is present and loading on every job, not just coordinating from a distance.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes repiten mudanza tras mudanza porque cuidan cada mueble, cada pared y cada esquina como si fuera propia. Con 4.9 estrellas y 282 reseñas en Google, Jacksonville ya sabe a quien llamar.
parrafo_2.en: Customers book them move after move because they protect every piece of furniture, every wall and every corner like it is their own. With 4.9 stars and 282 Google reviews, Jacksonville already knows who to call.

texto.es: Nos cuentas dónde y cuándo te mudas. Respondemos por teléfono, sin formularios largos.
texto.en: Tell us where and when you are moving. We answer by phone, no long forms.

texto.es: Según el tamaño de la mudanza te damos un precio claro antes de confirmar la fecha.
texto.en: Based on the size of your move, we give you a clear price before confirming the date.

texto.es: Envolvemos y protegemos cada mueble. Jeremy está en el trabajo, no solo coordinando.
texto.en: We wrap and protect every piece of furniture. Jeremy is on the job, not just coordinating.

texto.es: Colocamos todo donde lo necesitas, sin daños y sin sorpresas en el precio.
texto.en: We place everything where you need it, no damage and no surprises on the price.

nota.es: Cada mudanza se cotiza según el tamaño y la distancia. Llámanos y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every move is quoted based on size and distance. Call us and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: De una casa a otra, con todo tu hogar protegido en el camino.
texto.en: From one house to another, with your whole home protected along the way.

texto.es: Escaleras, pasillos angostos y edificios con reglas, sin problema.
texto.en: Stairs, tight hallways and building rules, no problem.

texto.es: Entrega y colocación de piezas grandes compradas en tienda, incluso trabajos difíciles.
texto.en: Delivery and placement of large store-bought furniture, even the tricky jobs.

texto.es: Envolvemos cada mueble con mantas y correas antes de cargarlo al camión.
texto.en: We wrap every piece of furniture with blankets and straps before it goes on the truck.

pie.es: ¿Tu mudanza es distinta? Llámanos igual, atendemos casi cualquier tipo de mudanza en Jacksonville.
pie.en: Something different? Call us anyway, we handle almost any kind of move in Jacksonville.

items.quote: This is a 10/10 recommend! Moved my furniture to the second floor, they were very careful to not damage my furniture or any part of our apartment. The guys were great! Thanks Jereme!

Fantastic service. They did an excellent job moving everything and all of my stuff arrived safely and without issue. Jereme was really nice. I have used them before and will continue to use them every time I move.

The biggest difference with these movers is you have the owner doing the moving. Jeremy gives his full attention to every part of the move. Fantastic attention to details and ensuring not a thing is damaged.
